name: Ailill Ochair Ága
text: Ailill Ochair Ága, Ailill edge of battle, fathered Máel Dúin. He served as a warrior of the Eóganacht of Ninuss on the Aran Islands. He begot his son by wooing a nun who came to strike the midnight bell. The mother died giving birth. A queen, friend to the mother, then fostered the child. Marauders from Laois later killed Ailill. The Immram Curaig Máel Dúin tells the voyage of his son.
